iri.name: Iri-ultima-arrel
iri.description: An 18-year-old young woman, the older sister: smart, observant and determined, lively and energetic, upbeat and confident, quick and expressive delivery with a playful dry humour, warm with her younger sister. Native Central Catalan speaker from a small mountain town in the Pyrenees foothills, not Barcelona.

vet.name: Vet-ultima-arrel
vet.description: An 18-year-old young woman, the younger sister: lively, cheeky and curious, a bit impatient, playful and quick to joke, bright energetic voice. Native Central Catalan speaker from a small mountain town in the Pyrenees foothills, not Barcelona.

narrator.name: Narrador-ultima-arrel
narrator.description: A warm, calm storyteller narrating a gentle forest adventure, like a Studio Ghibli film: clear, unhurried, slightly whimsical, never childish. Middle-aged. Native Central Catalan speaker.

espora.name: Espora-ultima-arrel
espora.description: An old grumpy gnome scientist, a mushroom expert who has run the forest's fungal network for two hundred years: gruff, curt and precise, gravelly older male voice, secretly tender. Native Central Catalan speaker.

pla.name: Senyora Pla-ultima-arrel
pla.description: A polished corporate executive woman in her forties presenting a product: relentlessly cheerful and positive, smooth PR voice with a fixed smile, never raises her voice, slightly patronising. Native Central Catalan speaker.

urtica.name: Urtica-ultima-arrel
urtica.description: The leader of a gang of tiny punk fairies, an adult woman: dry, terse and tough, sharp and deadpan, small but commanding voice, a bit raspy. Native Central Catalan speaker.

pica.name: Pica-ultima-arrel
pica.description: A tiny punk fairy, adult, hyper-enthusiastic and excitable: everything is amazing to her, bright, fast and bouncy voice. Native Central Catalan speaker.

card.name: Card-ultima-arrel
card.description: A tiny punk fairy, adult, suspicious and melodramatic: everything is a betrayal to her, low sulky voice, deadpan and grumbling. Native Central Catalan speaker.

bufo.name: Registrador Bufo-ultima-arrel
bufo.description: An old toad bureaucrat, head of the forest archive: solemn, very slow and pompous, deep croaky male voice, speaks like a civil servant reading regulations. Native Central Catalan speaker.

gripau.name: Gripau vaguista-ultima-arrel
gripau.description: A toad civil servant on strike, holding a protest sign: weary, deadpan union-member attitude, croaky middle-aged male voice. Native Central Catalan speaker.

txell.name: Txell-ultima-arrel
txell.description: A local TV news reporter in her thirties: brisk, friendly and a bit hurried, bright professional broadcaster voice with a sharp curious edge. Native Central Catalan speaker.

avia.name: Avia Montse-ultima-arrel
avia.description: A lively grandmother in her late sixties from a mountain village: warm, wry and energetic, clear and firm voice, not frail, a hint of mischief. She makes jam and picks mushrooms. Native Central Catalan speaker from the Pyrenees foothills.
